snippet.title: Smash it Wild | Release Date Trailer | Tactical Volleyball Roguelike
snippet.description:
🏐 Wishlist Smash it Wild on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2432240/Smash_It_Wild?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=release_trailer
📅 Releasing on April 16th!

Get ready to spike your way to victory! The official release of Smash it Wild is almost here. Dive into a unique blend of strategic positioning, roguelike progression, and high-stakes volleyball action. Draft your team, upgrade your stats, discover powerful synergies, and adapt your tactics to survive unpredictable encounters!

Will you be able to master the court and conquer every run?

🔔 Don't forget to Subscribe to follow our indie game development journey and get all the latest updates!

💬 Join the community:
https://discord.gg/kPVgE5g
